info.brief: Functions and constants for using websockets. Supported on all platforms.
info.description: Functions and constants for using websockets. Supported on all platforms.

elements.name: websocket.connect

parameters.name: params
parameters.doc: optional parameters as properties. The following parameters can be set

parameters.name: callback
parameters.doc: callback that receives all messages from the connection

fields.name: self
fields.doc: The script instance that was used to register the callback

elements.examples:
local function websocket_callback(self, conn, data)
    if data.event == websocket.EVENT_DISCONNECTED then
      log("Disconnected: " .. tostring(conn))
      self.connection = nil
      update_gui(self)
    elseif data.event == websocket.EVENT_CONNECTED then
      update_gui(self)
      log("Connected: " .. tostring(conn))
    elseif data.event == websocket.EVENT_ERROR then
      log("Error: '" .. data.message .. "'")
    elseif data.event == websocket.EVENT_MESSAGE then
      log("Receiving: '" .. tostring(data.message) .. "'")
    end
  end

  function init(self)
    self.url = "ws://echo.websocket.events"
    local params = {
      timeout = 3000,
      headers = "Sec-WebSocket-Protocol: chat\r\nOrigin: mydomain.com\r\n"
    }
    self.connection = websocket.connect(self.url, params, websocket_callback)
  end

  function finalize(self)
      if self.connection ~= nil then
        websocket.disconnect(self.connection)
      end
  end

elements.name: websocket.send

parameters.name: options
parameters.doc: options for this particular message. May be `nil`

elements.examples:
local function websocket_callback(self, conn, data)
    if data.event == websocket.EVENT_CONNECTED then
      websocket.send(conn, "Hello from the other side")
    end
  end

  function init(self)
    self.url = "ws://echo.websocket.org"
    local params = {}
    self.connection = websocket.connect(self.url, params, websocket_callback)
  end
